title: Execute and fix-delta prompts: commit first, focused tests in the foreground, never background, full gate is the daemon's
spec:
Why: headless Claude workers cap each shell command at 10 minutes; they ran the full gate (9-25 min), backgrounded it and exited without committing (luna T-0282, T-0425), and a worker running its own UI tests on the gate's simulator broke the daemon's gate (luna T-0557, 2026-09-30). execute.md:1 tells workers to run tests-green.sh until it exits 0.
What: rewrite the verify instructions in both prompts accordingly; keep every placeholder the renderer expects (spawn.render validates placeholders, so do not add or remove any {placeholder}; no double braces). Keep the rest of the prompts unchanged.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Commit first, then run the focused acceptance test in the foreground (uv run python -m pytest <id> -q). Never background a command and never run the full gate; the daemon gates externally. Acceptance ids are tests/<file>.py::<function or method name>; write the test as a unittest.TestCase method using tests/_harness.py like the neighbouring tests.
acceptance: tests/test_instructions.py::test_execute_prompt_commits_before_focused_tests passes: the rendered execute and fix-delta prompts say to commit before testing, to run only the acceptance-named tests in the foreground, never to background a command, that each command must finish under 10 minutes, and that the daemon runs the full gate; neither tells the worker to run tests-green.sh
